name: Advanced Toast Messages
description: A toast/notification system built on Single Directory Components (SDC), with PHP/Twig/JavaScript APIs, configurable type-to-component mapping, three-tier component fallback, and optional replacement of core status messages.
project_description:
A modern, flexible toast notification system for Drupal 10.3+ and Drupal 11 built on Single Directory Components (SDC).

 Motivation 
 Traditional Drupal messages appear at the top of the page, requiring users to scroll up to see feedback after form submissions or actions. Toast notifications solve this by displaying temporary, non-intrusive messages that appear in a fixed position (like bottom-right corner), providing immediate feedback without disrupting the user's workflow.

 This module provides a component-based toast system that integrates with Drupal's SDC architecture, allows theming control without touching module code, supports custom toast types per theme, provides PHP/Twig/JavaScript APIs, and can work alongside or replace standard Drupal messages.

 Key Features 
 
 Module-based components - status, warning, and error toasts out of the box 
 Theme extensibility - create custom toast types in your theme 
 Multiple APIs - trigger toasts from PHP services, Twig templates, or JavaScript 
 Drupal message replacement - optionally convert standard Drupal messages to toasts 
 Three-tier fallback system - ensures toasts render even if custom components are missing 
 Configurable admin UI - map toast types to components with validation 
 Accessible - ARIA live regions, keyboard support, respects prefers-reduced-motion 
 Cache-friendly lazy rendering - toasts render via lazy builders like core's status messages
